lines.text: Many learners say: Yesterday I go to the shop.
Better: Yesterday I went to the shop.
Went! Last week we went home.

data.wrong: Yesterday I go to the shop.
data.right: Yesterday I went to the shop.

en.tip: Yesterday needs the past: “Yesterday I went to the shop”.
en.caption: Do you also say “Yesterday I go to the shop.”? 😅 With yesterday you need the past: “went”, not “go”. Correct: “Yesterday I went to the shop.”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
